The Marne: the flank was attacked and the gap exploited. July 1918: the blow landed on an enemy already going back. Verdun: both banks held, by rotation. The Aisne: continued past forty-eight hours. The crisis of 1917: answered with remedy and repression together. March 1918: command was unified under Foch. 1915: operations limited to the artillery available. The Somme: committed alongside the British. La Malmaison: stopped on its objective. The order to go back: the withdrawal ordered on 25 August. The commanders: the failures relieved.
